summary: The datum for 𝔪′ is obtained from that for 𝔪 by the Hecke polynomial at v acting through the pair Weil representation (`sum_heckePolyCoeff_smul_pairWeil`); on class sums this becomes a sum over the coset representatives of the basic double cosets at v, which the q-binomial count turns into ∏_{l<n}(1 − q_v^lX).

steps.claim: The places of 𝔪′ are disjoint from their conjugates.
steps.lean: (card n) (α.frobValue n v)⁻¹ * detPeriod n α c 𝔪 ψ := have d := hS ▸ 𝔪'.disjoint_places_star

steps.claim: v is not the conjugate of a place of 𝔪′ (disjointness of the places of 𝔪′ from their conjugates).

steps.lean: have u := h.charUnramifiedAt (hψ v hv) (by simp_all)

steps.claim: For every modulus, the lift of χ∘det to finite adelic matrices is a residue datum (`liftFn_eq_residueDatum`).
steps.lean:
have l 𝔪 := by simpa [← RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, ← RingHom.map_det] using
    (liftFn_eq_residueDatum (𝔪 := 𝔪) Subtype.range_coe.symm fun S ↦ ∏ᶠ w, ψ _ (det (n := n) (S w)))

steps.claim: H(P): the Hecke-polynomial combination of the pair Weil action at v on the modular datum for 𝔪 is the modular datum for 𝔪′ (for each polynomial P).
steps.lean:
have H P := (sum_heckePolyCoeff_smul_pairWeil u u hw (f := modDatum (stdSpace ..) (stdSpace E n) 𝔪
    (𝔪.charOfTamePart ψ ·.det) P) (by grind [modDatum, projOn_integrated, projOn_name_vacElem])
    _).1.trans (c := modDatum _ _ _ (𝔪'.charOfTamePart ψ ·.det) P) (by
    simp [modDatum, integrated_name]
    erw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (by simp [AutChar.frobValue, HeckeChar.atUnif]),
      ← name_union (S := {v}) _ d (by simpa)
      (hΨ := Set.range_const (ι := Unit) ▸ isSchwartzBruhat_residueDatum _ (by simpa)), l, l]
    simp +unfoldPartialApp [residueDatum, hS, Pi.mul_def, ← ite_and, finprod_eq_prod_of_fintype,
      reindex_equiv ((Set.equivOfEq hS).trans (Set.subtypeInsertEquivOption hv)).symm]
    congr!; bound; show _ = ψ v (det (.map _ (residueOrZero ∘ evalAt v)))
    erw [hψ v hv, MulChar.trivial_apply]
    split <;> simp_all [rank_of_isUnit, card_sub_rank, prod_eq_zero (i := 0), zero_lt_iff,
      coe_mulVecLin, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit, ↓← isUnit_iff_isUnit_det])

steps.claim: Unfold the modular data as names of residue data.
Cancel the factor frobValue·its inverse and combine the names over 𝔪 and {v} (`name_union`, the places being disjoint), using the residue-datum form.
steps.lean:
erw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (by simp [AutChar.frobValue, HeckeChar.atUnif]),
      ← name_union (S := {v}) _ d (by simpa)
      (hΨ := Set.range_const (ι := Unit) ▸ isSchwartzBruhat_residueDatum _ (by simpa)), l, l]

steps.claim: Reindex the places of 𝔪′ as those of 𝔪 plus v.
steps.lean:
simp +unfoldPartialApp [residueDatum, hS, Pi.mul_def, ← ite_and, finprod_eq_prod_of_fintype,
      reindex_equiv ((Set.equivOfEq hS).trans (Set.subtypeInsertEquivOption hv)).symm]

steps.claim: Reduce to the factor at v.
The factor at v is ψ_v(det of the reduction at v).
The trivial character evaluates to 1 on invertible and 0 on singular reductions; matching the indicator of full-rank matrices.
steps.lean:
split <;> simp_all [rank_of_isUnit, card_sub_rank, prod_eq_zero (i := 0), zero_lt_iff,
      coe_mulVecLin, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit, ↓← isUnit_iff_isUnit_det])

steps.claim: s: for every modulus with tame part trivial off it, K₀ lies in the right stabilizer of the kernel (α-equivariance under K₀).
steps.lean:
have s {𝔪} (u : ∀ w ∉ 𝔪.places, ψ w = 1) : Kf .. ≤ rightStab
    (detKernel n α c 𝔪 (𝔪.charOfTamePart ψ ·.det)) := Subtype.forall'.2 (by simp [detKernel,
    modKernel_mul_Kf_right, Pi.smul_def, h.apply_det_eq_charOfTamePart u, ←map_mul, ← det_mul])
steps.typed_fact:
Kf .. ≤ rightStab
    (detKernel n α c 𝔪 (𝔪.charOfTamePart ψ ·.det))

steps.claim: Rewrite both class sums as class integrals over K₀ (s), expand the Hecke operator at v as a sum over the basic coset representatives (left invariance, `detKernel_embFin_mul`), insert H, and count: the sum over cosets of the Hecke coefficients gives ∏_{l<n}(1 − q_v^lX) (`q_binomial_submodule`).
steps.lean:
by rw [detPeriod, stdClassSum, ← classIntegral_eq_classSum (s (by simp_all)),
    classIntegral_sum univ (.mulLeft <| heckePolyCoeff (α.frobValue n v)⁻¹ ·)
    (atSplit hw <| transposeGL <| basicCosetRep ·) fun _ ↦ ⟨Set.forall_mem_range.2
    (detKernel_embFin_mul _), Subgroup.isOpen_mono (s hψ) isOpen_Kf⟩] <;> simp [detKernel,
    modKernel, ← H, pairTheta, rep_apply_apply, detPeriod, classIntegral_eq_classSum (s hψ),
    ← sum_mul, ← card_ResField, by simpa using q_binomial_submodule n (ResField v) ⊤]
